sources.claim: PostgreSQL clients appear in Render’s list of tools available at build and runtime for all native languages; exact provider versions not measured.
pg_restore can emit SQL from a non-plain pg_dump archive to a file/stdout without connecting to a database.
Debian bookworm distributes PostgreSQL15 client programs and their package dependencies.

D7_boundary: ADR060 m82 records that its FFmpeg delivery is not a blanket tools bundle; this new fixture checks one named PostgreSQL-client gap and proposes no completion or reopening of m82.
